import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'survived': [0, 1, 1, 1, 0],
    'pclass': [3, 1, 3, 1, 3],
    'sex': ['male', 'female', 'female', 'female', 'male'],
    'age': [22.0, 38.0, 26.0, 35.0, 35.0],
    'sibsp': [1, 1, 0, 1, 0],
    'parch': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'fare': [7.25, 71.2833, 7.925, 53.1, 8.05],
    'embarked': ['S', 'C', 'S', 'S', 'S'],
    'class': ['Third', 'First', 'Third', 'First', 'Third'],
    'who': ['man', 'woman', 'woman', 'woman', 'man'],
    'adult_male': [True, False, False, False, True],
    'deck': [np.nan, 'C', np.nan, 'C', np.nan],
    'embark_town': ['Southampton', 'Cherbourg', 'Southampton', 'Southampton', 'Southampton'],
    'alive': ['no', 'yes', 'yes', 'yes', 'no'],
    'alone': [False, False, True, False, True]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set up the visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Survival by class and sex
survival_pivot = df.pivot_table(index='class', columns='sex', values='survived', aggfunc='mean')
survival_pivot.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[0,0], color=['lightcoral', 'lightblue'])
axes[0,0].set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Sex')
axes[0,0].set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
axes[0,0].set_xlabel('Class')
axes[0,0].legend(title='Sex')
axes[0,0].set_ylim(0, 1)

# 2. Age distribution by survival
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='alive', y='age', ax=axes[0,1], palette='Set2')
axes[0,1].set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status')
axes[0,1].set_xlabel('Survived')
axes[0,1].set_ylabel('Age')

# 3. Fare distribution by class
sns.violinplot(data=df, x='class', y='fare', ax=axes[0,2], palette='viridis')
axes[0,2].set_title('Fare Distribution by Class')
axes[0,2].set_xlabel('Class')
axes[0,2].set_ylabel('Fare')

# 4. Survival count by embarkation town
embark_survival = df.groupby(['embark_town', 'alive']).size().unstack()
embark_survival.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=axes[1,0], color=['lightcoral', 'lightgreen'])
axes[1,0].set_title('Survival Count by Embarkation Town')
axes[1,0].set_xlabel('Embarkation Town')
axes[1,0].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[1,0].legend(title='Survived')

# 5. Correlation heatmap of numerical features
numerical_cols = ['survived', 'pclass', 'age', 'sibsp', 'parch', 'fare']
corr_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', center=0, ax=axes[1,1])
axes[1,1].set_title('Correlation Heatmap of Numerical Features')

# 6. Alone status by survival
alone_survival = df.groupby(['alone', 'alive']).size().unstack()
alone_survival.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[1,2], color=['lightblue', 'lightcoral'])
axes[1,2].set_title('Alone Status by Survival')
axes[1,2].set_xlabel('Alone')
axes[1,2].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[1,2].legend(title='Survived')
axes[1,2].set_xticklabels(['Not Alone', 'Alone'], rotation=0)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
